# External Data

This folder is reserved for external/supplementary datasets (e.g. industry
benchmarks, supplier master data) that could be joined with the primary
manufacturing dataset in a future iteration of this project.

No external dataset was provided or used in the current version of this
project — `manufacturing_defect_dataset.csv` (in `data/raw/`) is the only
data source, and it is a single, self-contained flat table that does not
require any external data to be joined or referenced.
